description:
Adidev Technologies Inc 
 
 www.adidevtechnologies.com 
 
 

 
 URGENT NEED FOR ANDROID DEVELOPERS! - HIRING PROCESS ONLY 24-48 HOURS! 
 
 

 
 Adidev Technologies is looking for entry-level and mid-level Android developers with ½ year - to 3 years of experience. Must be open to relocation and working onsite following the lifting of Covid-19 restrictions (if requested by the client). Must be a driven self-starter. Salary will vary depending on experience and we are seeking candidates that are looking to start as soon as possible. Must have excellent written and oral communication, as well as the desire and ability to work well in a team environment.
 
 

 
 If you are looking for a new challenge and are ready to make an impact on a growing team, then this will be a perfect fit for you. As an Android developer for Adidev Technologies, you will be optimizing, building, and troubleshooting large-scale applications for our globally-recognized enterprise-level clients.
 
 

 
 We are a software consulting company that is still rapidly growing and expanding and having established ourselves as a go-to resource to our highly-visible clients, we remain ready to take on new partnerships, and to do so we are in search of brilliant Android developers to join our team to make it possible. Not only do we offer a great team and support structure, but we also offer you the opportunity to make an immediate impact and grow your skillset at the same time.
 
 

 
 

 
 Qualifications and Skills: 
 
 

 
 
 At least 2 years of experience with Java
 
 Exposure to, or a willingness to learn Kotlin
 
 At least 1 application published to the PlayStore and familiar with SDLC
 
 Strong knowledge of Android SDK, different versions of Android, exposure to Android Studio
 
 Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
 
 Knowledge of the open-source Android ecosystem and the libraries available for common tasks
Familiarity with RESTful APIs to connect Android applications to back-end services
 
 Comfortable with Git and source control
 
 A strong work ethic and the ability to manage yourself and your time
 
 Excellent communication skills - both written and verbal
 
 
 

 
 What you can expect: 
 
 

 
 Competitive Salary
Paid Relocation (when applicable)
Remote Support
Guaranteed Regular Salary Reviews
Job Type: W2 or Contract 1099 (full time - 40 hours)
 
 Salary: $60k to $90k or $30/hr to $45/hr (Commensurate with experience)
 
 

 
 Required experience: 
 
 

 
 Java: 2 years
Kotlin: 6 months (or willing to learn)
Android SDK
Familiarity with SLDC
